column1: # CERTA's full certification against the slow but reliable mappers, galaxy (2026-10-22): Ampere Altra, every run pinned to cores 0-63 (taskset), 64 threads; certa-gpu rows add one A100 (device 1). Build ea812d8. Index loading included; one session.

# Short reads: 2,000,000 HG002 NovaSeq X reads (reads/hg002_2M.fq) or pairs; RazerS 3 on the first 200,000 reads / pairs, CERTA timed on the same (data *-200000). CERTA rows: interval mode (every read a record), medians of three runs; the other tools one run each (their SAM kept for slow_reliability.txt).

# Settings: CERTA certificate radius <= 5 edits; Yara 1.0.5 -e 4 -y full (every alignment with <= 4 % errors, i.e. 6 edits at 150 bp); RazerS 3 3.5.12 -i 96 -rr 100 (100 % recognition of matches with >= 96 % identity; pairs -ll 450 -le 400). RazerS 3's paired mode aborted (std::bad_alloc, exit 134) at the end of the run, also with -le 150 on 20,000 pairs: its row is the time to the abort.

# HiFi: 242,534 HG002 HiFi reads (hifi_1x.fa). CERTA's long-read pipeline is minimap2 2.31 -x map-hifi + tools/lr_ceiling --certify (OPT proven for 226,330 reads, 93.32 %); Winnowmap 2.03 -x map-pb -W (meryl k = 15, distinct > 0.9998) indexes the FASTA in every run (88.5 s of its 610.4 s; its dumped index crashes on load). lr_ceiling on Winnowmap's alignments is a check of them, not part of a pipeline (slow_hifi_and_logs.txt).
# Script: bench/slow_bench.sh (sections certa razers hifi, then yara winnowmap check); indexes: bench/slow_index.sh.
